"''Uh...the Jedi have disarmed the bombs.|This droid speaking to Darts D'Nar|{{TCW|Kidnapped}}}} This '''battle droid''' was stationed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kiros/Legends|Kiros]] and participated in the [[Battle of Kiros]]. ==Biography== During the Battle of Kiros, this [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]] tried contacting [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] commander [[Darts D'Nar/Legends|Darts D'Nar]] to inform him that two [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] ([[Padawan/Legends|padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] and Jedi [[General/Legends|General]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]]) are destroying the bombs planted through out the city, but at the time the [[Zygerrian/Legends|Zygerrian]] was fighting [[High Jedi General/Legends|High Jedi General]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], who managed to break the [[Holoprojector/Legends|Holoprojector]] in the fight and the droid's transmission was interrupted. The droid successfully contacted Darts D'Nar later and informed him that the Jedi had already destroyed the two thermal detonator bombs. ==Behind the scenes== The B1 battle droid, like every battle droid in [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''The Clone Wars'' movie]] and [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars|''The Clone Wars'' TV series]], was voiced by [[Matthew Wood]]. His name was never given. ==Appearances== *{{TCW|Kidnapped}} {{1st}} {{Hologram}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} [[Category:B1-series battle droids]] [[Category:Droids of the Confederacy of Independent Systems]]
